110.description: Fartweeze trails a small comedic cloud wherever it goes and looks faintly embarrassed about it every single time. It exists purely to make people laugh, and it's very good at its job. Traders know it as $FARTCOIN, tied to Fartcoin.

126.description: Spexmar wears a permanently smug half-smile, trading-chart squiggles rippling faintly across its flanks. It insists its confidence has nothing to do with the numbers. Traders know it as $SPX, tied to SPX6900.

132.description: Uselessto never settles into one true form, its flat printed shrug-face always mid-shrug. It insists it has no purpose at all, which some find strangely reassuring. Traders know it as $USELESS, tied to Useless Coin.

133.description: Muchwow's grin never fades, no matter the situation. Tiny caption bubbles are said to orbit its head at all times, though nobody has ever quite managed to read what they say. Traders know it as $DOGE, tied to Dogecoin.

137.description: Memerygon's faceted body constantly reshuffles its own geometry, flickering through a simple smiling expression. It seems to exist purely to be looked at and shared. Traders know it as $MEME, tied to Memecoin.

140.description: Ordinite carries the very first inscription rune ever etched, faintly glowing beneath weathered stone-and-shell armor. Every inscribed creature after it owes something to that first mark. Traders know it as $ORDI, tied to Ordi.

174.description: Wenpuff vibrates visibly whenever it's made to wait, the tiny clock-hand on its head ticking faster and faster. Nobody has ever managed to make it wait patiently for long. Traders know it as $WEN, tied to Wen.

186.description: Brettoad wears its knit beanie like it grew there naturally. Its half-lidded smirk suggests it always knows something you don't. Traders know it as $BRETT, tied to Based Brett.

194.description: Fwoggo's eyes never quite point in the same direction at once, and its mouth hangs open in a permanent, endearing derp. It has no idea how charming this makes it. Traders know it as $FWOG, tied to Fwog.

209.description: Myropup has one ear that never quite stands up straight, no matter how many times it tries. It doesn't seem to mind, and neither does anyone who's spent time with it. Traders know it as $MYRO, tied to Myro.

210.description: Samoyeti's grin never leaves its face, even buried nose-deep in snow. A light dusting of frost clings permanently to its ruff, no matter the season. Traders know it as $SAMO, tied to Samoyedcoin.

219.description: Pumpcargo's shell occasionally flares molten-orange and lifts clean off the ground for a few eager seconds before settling back down. It never quite decides if it wants to be fast or slow. Traders know it as $PUMP, tied to pump.fun.

228.description: Astrohound wears a cracked glass dome over its head that never seems to run out of air. It has been chasing a small red dot across the sky for as long as anyone can remember. Traders know it as $ELON, tied to Dogelon Mars.

229.description: Bonkhound's front paws are built for one purpose: a single comedic, oversized bonk. It never actually hurts anyone — the joke is the whole point. Traders know it as $BONK, tied to Bonk.

235.description: Wojaki's fur is drawn in heavy cross-hatched lines, as if it had been sketched in a hurry and never finished. Its exhausted expression rarely changes, no matter how good things are actually going. Traders know it as $WOJAK, tied to Wojak.

256.description: Coqusken struts everywhere chest-first, its ember-bright comb impossible to miss. It crows loudest right before sunrise, whether anyone's awake to hear it or not. Traders know it as $COQ, tied to Coq Inu.

261.description: Babypup is small enough to fit in two hands, but it puffs itself up whenever it senses danger nearby. Its pacifier-shaped nose charm never quite falls off, no matter how hard it plays. Traders know it as $BABYDOGE, tied to Baby Doge Coin.

262.description: Shibazan rarely needs to raise its voice or bare its teeth. It was the first of its kind to prove a meme could hold its ground like a champion, and it has carried itself with that quiet confidence ever since. Traders know it as $SHIB, tied to Shiba Inu.

263.description: Kishuzig's zigzag racing stripes aren't just decoration — nothing has ever caught it running in a straight line for long. It considers a direct chase beneath it. Traders know it as $KISHU, tied to Kishu Inu.

264.description: Akitako sits upright at the entrance to wherever it has decided to live, dignified and unmoving. Locals say a home guarded by one is never troubled twice. Traders know it as $AKITA, tied to Akita Inu.

287.description: Mumuloth stands upright but never quite seems fully awake, a permanently drowsy half-smile fixed on its face. Its naivety is disarming, right up until it isn't. Traders know it as $MUMU, tied to Mumu.

288.description: Sigmaroth stands rigidly apart from the crowd, arms crossed, expression unreadable. It considers needing anyone else a weakness it refuses to have. Traders know it as $SIGMA, tied to Sigma.

289.description: Slerfloth moves so slowly that a single scorch mark on its chest has never quite faded. It famously dozed off once and accidentally let its entire stash burn away — it insists it has learned its lesson. Traders know it as $SLERF, tied to Slerf.

297.description: Gigachard's jawline is said to be perfectly symmetrical from every angle, and its confidence never wavers. It has never once been seen breaking a sweat. Traders know it as $GIGA, tied to Gigachad.

300.description: Popcatta freezes mid-yawn the instant anyone looks its way, mouth stretched impossibly wide. Blink, and it's already closed again. Traders know it as $POPCAT, tied to Popcat.

301.description: Mewcatta is rendered in only two flat colours and an almost expressionless face, and somehow that's exactly what makes it so easy to love. Traders know it as $MEW, tied to Mew.

302.description: Sabletroll's gap-toothed grin appears right before something goes comedically wrong for somebody nearby. It has never once apologized, and it never will. Traders know it as $TROLL, tied to Trollface.

309.description: Voltrike crackles faintly with static even at rest, its tail acting as a small natural lightning rod. It's best not to pet it during a storm. Traders know it as $VOLT, tied to Volt Inu.

310.description: Doggomoon stands on its hind legs and reaches skyward every night without fail. It has never quite reached the moon, but nobody has ever seen it stop trying. Traders know it as $DOG, tied to DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON.

324.description: Turboshell's shell is painted with racing stripes it has never once lived up to. It insists it is extremely fast, given enough time. Traders know it as $TURBO, tied to Turbo.

334.description: Higheraria spirals upward with a permanently hopeful expression, sunrise-gradient feathers trailing behind it. It never seems to believe there's a ceiling worth respecting. Traders know it as $HIGHER, tied to Higher.

375.description: A16zoid studies everything through a single cold, analytical eye-lens, its tailored blazer-plating never wrinkling. It rarely commits to anything without running the numbers twice. Traders know it as $AI16Z, tied to ai16z.

393.description: Penguplup waddles on tiny feet, round and soft in a way that makes it very hard to look away from. Its flippers are too short to reach much of anything, which somehow makes it more endearing. Traders know it as $PENGU, tied to Pudgy Penguins.

417.description: Pnutkin stuffs its cheeks impossibly full and curls its fluffy tail protectively around itself when startled. It is beloved by nearly everyone who has ever met it. Traders know it as $PNUT, tied to Peanut the Squirrel.

431.description: Miladyow poses more than it moves, a tiny flower clip never out of place in its fur. Its slightly smug pout suggests it already knows it's being admired. Traders know it as $LADYS, tied to Milady Meme Coin.

432.description: Moggrin's grin stretches so wide it looks almost uncomfortable, yet it never seems to tire of smiling. Its bulging cheerful eyes miss absolutely nothing. Traders know it as $MOG, tied to Mog Coin.

450.description: Moodango is small enough to hold in two arms and pink enough to make anyone smile on sight. Its startled wide-eyed expression became famous practically overnight. Traders know it as $MOODENG, tied to Moo Deng.

506.description: Wifpup's pink knitted beanie never comes off, no matter how it plays. Its gentle squinting smile has made it one of the most recognisable Stockmonsters in the whole roster. Traders know it as $WIF, tied to dogwifhat.

507.description: Kibherd's fur hangs so far over its eyes that it's a wonder it can see anything at all. It has never once lost track of the friend it's following. Traders know it as $KIBA, tied to Kiba Inu.

518.description: Actmuse drifts through its own dream-fog, faint glyphs circling its closed eyes. What it foresees rarely makes sense until long after it's already happened. Traders know it as $ACT, tied to Act I: The AI Prophecy.

537.description: Pepetoad is happiest sitting perfectly still in warm mud, heavy-lidded and unbothered. Its calm seems to spread to anyone who sits with it long enough. Traders know it as $PEPE, tied to Pepe.

552.description: Crocorok lies half-submerged in mud for so long that its armor plates crack and dry in place. Its lazy half-lidded grin never quite closes all the way. Traders know it as $CROC, tied to Croc.

559.description: Degenaggy slouches everywhere in trousers that never seem to stay up on their own. It takes every risk with the same lazy grin, win or lose. Traders know it as $DEGEN, tied to Degen.

560.description: Snekrafty holds its punk-rock crest high and its smirk higher. Its circuit-like scale patterns shift faintly whenever it's about to cause trouble. Traders know it as $SNEK, tied to Snek.

580.description: Quacklett's oversized webbed feet make an enthusiastic slapping sound with every step, and its cheerful quack rarely stops for long. Traders know it as $QUACK, tied to Quack.

656.description: Apufrolic smiles at everything with genuine, uncomplicated happiness, eyes slightly crossed in delight. It has never once had an unkind thought about anybody. Traders know it as $APU, tied to Apu Apustaja.

660.description: Ratsby's tail is covered in tally-mark scratches that look almost deliberate, like an ancient inscription nobody has finished reading yet. Traders know it as $RATS, tied to Rats.

672.description: Goatrophet speaks rarely, and always in riddles that only make sense much later. Its braided beard is said to hold a charm for every prophecy it has ever whispered. Traders know it as $GOAT, tied to Goatseus Maximus.

674.description: Gokuchamp's fur stands on end the instant it focuses, faint energy wisps curling off its shoulders. It trains constantly, chasing a stronger version of itself that always stays just out of reach. Traders know it as $GOKU, tied to Goku.

675.description: Harambro rests one paw over its heart whenever it stands still. Its gentle, dignified gaze has made it an enduring symbol long after it was first remembered. Traders know it as $HARAMBE, tied to Harambe.

676.description: Neirofrou is always immaculately styled, not a single pom-pom tuft out of place. Some say it shares more than a passing resemblance to a certain famous internet dog. Traders know it as $NEIRO, tied to Neiro.

677.description: Toshimew sits bolt upright like an official statue, a single geometric mark glowing faintly on its brow. It never seems to blink first. Traders know it as $TOSHI, tied to Toshi.

678.description: Michiwhisk never goes anywhere without its small canvas backpack, wide-eyed and endlessly curious about wherever it ends up next. Traders know it as $MICHI, tied to Michi.

725.description: Keycatten's paws are always poised as if mid-keystroke, ready to perform on command. Once it starts playing, it rarely wants to stop. Traders know it as $KEYCAT, tied to Keyboard Cat.

726.description: Hosicat's oversized folded ears and huge glossy eyes give it a permanently surprised look, even when nothing surprising is happening at all. Traders know it as $HOSICO, tied to Hosico.

745.description: Flokrag wears its horned headband as though it were born fused to its skull. It howls before a fight not out of anger, but tradition. Traders know it as $FLOKI, tied to Floki Inu.

759.description: Chillbear strolls everywhere at exactly the same unhurried pace, paws tucked comfortably out of sight. Nothing seems to bother it, and it would rather keep it that way. Traders know it as $CHILLGUY, tied to Just a Chill Guy.

760.description: Bobocub stands with its arms crossed and a disappointed frown fixed in place, a small rain-cloud-shaped cowlick never quite drying out. It expects the worst and is rarely surprised. Traders know it as $BOBO, tied to Bobo.

765.description: Bomesage carries a glowing open book against its chest at all times, pages turning on their own. It never explains what's written inside, only that it's important. Traders know it as $BOME, tied to Book of Meme.

766.description: Ponkey swings from place to place with one eyebrow permanently raised, as if daring you to ask what it's up to. It usually is up to something. Traders know it as $PONKE, tied to Ponke.
